title: Music City Retreat - 2 bedroom with Hot Tub
description:
Are you Looking for a Nashville vacation, but don't want the hassle and high-prices of downtown??? Stay with us in one of our best locations only 6 miles from Broadway. This two-bedroom is newly renovated and newly furnished unit is centrally located to some of the best eateries and shopping that Nashville has to offer. Downtown Nashville is only a quick Uber away, with other major attractions easily accessible. Perfect for 6-8 guests, with free parking at the door.

The space
The Sleeping Space--
Bedroom #1: 1 king (attached toilet and sink)
Bedroom #2: 2 twin over 2 full bunk beds (attached toilet and sink)

Bathroom #1: tub/shower combo

About the home:
-2 bedroom
-2.5 bathroom (one tub/shower combo; each room has private toilet)
-8 people accommodation max

House Amenities:
-WiFi
-Smart TVs
-Basic Amenities (paper products, soaps, trash bags, etc)
-Linens Provided
-Stocked Kitchen

OTHER THINGS TO NOTE:
-- No parties, excessive noise, or illegal activity of any kind.
-- Check-in is any time after 3 p.m. Check-out by 10 a.m.
-- Parking is provided for Two (2) vehicle, however, there is visitor parking for additional vehicles.
-- Primary renter must be over the age of 21.
-- Maximum occupancy is never to exceed 8 people.
-- The base rate is based on 6 guests. There is an extra fee of $25 per person per night over SIX guests to a maximum of EIGHT and this includes children and infants. This pricing allows smaller groups and families to enjoy my home without paying the same price as larger groups.
--***ATTENTION*** Please make sure you read the house rules prior to booking, as we strictly enforce them to stay in compliance in Nashville, including mandatory taxes and damage insurance waivers.

Local Permit # - Issued Year 2020 followed by 006 then 582- this is required to legally rent in Nashville.
